lines.x: The Indian rupee appreciated past 93 per US dollar to reach a seven-month high, supported by lower crude oil prices and equity inflows.
Gold fell below $3,800 per ounce, hitting a 14-month low alongside silver due to a strengthening US dollar and Fed interest rate outlooks.
India's benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield fell to 7.2393% from 7.2528%, extending a rally supported by lower oil prices and easing US sovereign bond yields.
Foreign portfolio investors injected over ₹1 lakh crore into Indian equities in November, driving the Nifty 50 index to a nine-month high.
